references.text: Noah was also described as one who walked with God, which reflects Enoch's relationship with God.
In Hebrews, Enoch is mentioned as an example of faith because he walked with God and was taken up to heaven.
The verse elaborates on Enoch's walk with God and states that God took him away, which is the direct continuation of v. 22.
Micah describes walking humbly with God as a central requirement, giving theological depth to the expression "to walk with God".
